title: LoRa TDMA schedule (proposed contract)

schedule_version.description: Backend monotonic uint32 draft (per Gateway namespace), NOT a raw RF 8-bit SCHED_VER. Cross-layer mapping is BLOCKED at #12.

created_at.description: Backend-issued UTC timestamp; semantic validation requires created_at < expires_at.

expires_at.description: Absolute UTC proposal/command acceptance deadline; MQTT Message Expiry is separate and also mandatory.

profile_id.description: Identifier for an RF/schedule profile explicitly approved for this Gateway. P-10S-15 is example/mock only; G1/G2/G3 not verified.

superframe_ms.description: Superframe duration; validation must match separately approved RF timing/airtime profile, not assume 10000ms.

min_announce_superframes.description: Number of complete announcement superframes (candidate min not evidence Node ACK). C04 requires affected Node prepare ACK and old slot lease safe termination before activation.

slots.description: Each node_id scoped to gateway_id; slot IDs, offsets, durations and guards must conform to an approved RF profile and not overlap; shadow/lease/cutover checked semantically, not by schema alone.

activation_window.description: Owner-approved earliest/latest UTC time at which Gateway may select a local superframe boundary. Backend checks Owner authorization, ordered bounds; Gateway validates trusted-time confidence and must fail closed if not provable.

description: DRAFT G0-aligned C03/C04 schedule proposal. Owner-approved activation window required; Gateway does not modify Slot Assignment, requires affected-Node prepare ACK and safe old lease termination. Numeric timing not frozen.
